1. Call for admission to the PhD Courses 2026/27 – 42° cycle
The University of Padua has published a 2nd Call for Admissions to the PhD Programmes for the 2026/2027 academic year (42nd cycle). Detailed information regarding the PhD Programmes and the application procedures is available on the official University website. Please visit: https://www.unipd.it/dottorato/bandi-graduatorie
It is mandatory to use the form for the application to the PhD Course in Industrial Engineering. For the forma click the icon.
×
2. Evaluation and Colloquia
Candidates who achieve a score of at least 63/90 in the evaluation of qualifications will be admitted to the oral examination. Depending on the preference specified in the application, candidates may attend the oral exam either in person or remotely. Each candidate is required to prepare a single-slide presentation summarizing their doctoral project proposal according to the template available at the icon link.
The presentation must be prepared strictly according to the instructions and format provided. for the forma click the icon.
